name: city-jump

scripts.balance: tsc --ignoreConfig --rootDir src --outDir .tmp/balance --module ESNext --moduleResolution bundler --target ES2022 --strict --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --noEmit false src/sim/wave.ts src/sim/batteries.ts src/sim/kaiju.ts src/sim/vec.ts src/sim/slots.ts src/sim/zones.ts src/sim/graph.ts src/sim/rules.ts src/sim/facing.ts src/sim/roadTypes.ts src/sim/heightmap.ts && node --experimental-specifier-resolution=node scripts/balance.mjs
scripts.ci: npm test && npm run test:architecture && npm run build && npm run logics:validate

author: Alexandre Agostini
description: A browser-based 3D city builder where roads, terrain, buildings, and traffic derive from a playable road graph.
